preconditions.description: The chessboard dimension n is an integer between 3 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.split()) == 8 and all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdin.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: The input contains exactly 8 integers: n, a_x, a_y, b_x, b_y, c_x, c_y, where each coordinate is between 1 and n inclusive.
The king's initial position (b_x, b_y) is not the same as the queen's position (a_x, a_y).
The target position (c_x, c_y) is not the same as the queen's position (a_x, a_y).
The target position (c_x, c_y) is not the same as the king's initial position (b_x, b_y).

preconditions.expression: not is_in_check(b_x, b_y, a_x, a_y) and not is_in_check(c_x, c_y, a_x, a_y)
preconditions.description: The king's initial position (b_x, b_y) and target position (c_x, c_y) are not in check by the queen (a_x, a_y).

postconditions.expression: (stdout.strip() == 'YES') == exists_path(b_x, b_y, c_x, c_y, a_x, a_y, n)
postconditions.description: The output is 'YES' if and only if there exists a valid path for the king from (b_x, b_y) to (c_x, c_y) where no square on the path is in check by the queen (a_x, a_y).

invariants.expression: lambda x, y, qx, qy: abs(x - qx) == abs(y - qy) or x == qx or y == qy
invariants.description: A square (x, y) is in check by the queen at (qx, qy) if it lies on the same row, column, or diagonal.

invariants.expression: lambda x, y, qx, qy: 1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n
invariants.description: All coordinates (x, y) are within the bounds of the n x n chessboard.
